data.name: Avrille
data.long_meaning: From the Old French name Averil, meaning 'raven', derived from the Latin avis meaning 'bird'. In Christian tradition, Avrille is believed to be a French diminutive of Averillus, a Latin name meaning 'raven' or 'messenger of the gods'. As a Christian name, Avrille symbolizes dedication, commitment, and the role of a messenger or servant of God.
